rules.relation: Comparisons obtained from GitHub compare with original ref as base and selected source as head; ANCESTOR=branch reachable from selected source, DIVERGED=independent unique commits, TIP_DESCENDANT=branch ahead of selected source.
rules.disposition: History inclusion never implies current functional behavior. Review unique deltas and test contracts before marking accepted.
rules.exceptions: Specific branch-only changed paths and their interpretation are recorded in docs/migrations/PHASE_A_BRANCH_DISPOSITION.md. Original PR #34 is rejected rather than activated; C01 persistence is included but not authoritative.
rules.changedFiles: branchOnlyChangedPaths on divergent/descendant refs is merge-base-to-tip (for RSCode original main to branch); paths are exact GitHub compare file names, not proof of active functionality.
rules.perRefEvidence: Rows include exact original tip, any associated original PR title/state from PHASE0_REPOSITORY_INVENTORY.json, selected source subtree SHA and active candidate test paths. The source test paths do not prove historical branch behavior unless explicitly accepted.
